svg.aria-label: Sketch: vessels at anchor in the Strait of Hormuz near Bandar Abbas, Iran, in dawn haze. In the foreground a long, low flat-deck cargo vessel seen slightly from above, its deck lined with rows of small vehicles, a three-story white stern house with a mast at its right end and a small mast at the bow. Behind it, fainter in the haze, a trawler-like ship at left, a landing-craft barge with its bow ramp raised at centre, and an offshore supply vessel with a tall superstructure at right. A single bird crosses at far left. No people in the scene.
